name: Brompheniramine Maleate

fda.text: Do not use ▪ to sedate a child or to make a child sleepy Ask a doctor before use if you have ▪ trouble urinating due to an enlarged prostate gland ▪ glaucoma ▪ a breathing problem such as emphysema, or chronic bronchitis. Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are ▪ taking sedatives or tranquilizers When using…

summary: This medicine must not be used to make a child sleepy or to calm them down [3]. You must check with a doctor before taking it if you have trouble urinating from an enlarged prostate gland, glaucoma, or lung issues like chronic bronchitis or emphysema, which is a breathing problem [3]. You also need to consult a doctor or pharmacist if you take medicines to calm you down or help you sleep, called sedatives or tranquilizers [3]. In addition, computer model estimates that were not tested in people show a low score of 11 for the liver and a medium score of 54 for the heart [M].
